_comment: #1180 compound-question fixtures. A compound question carries two information needs in one query; pre-#1180 the RRF-fused candidates were cut to the final top-5 by whole-query overlap, so chunks serving the dominant need (e.g. permission/role chunks) crowded the other need's best chunk (e.g. the identifier-format chunk of glossary.identifiers) out of the context window. This is the item-4 probe residual verified live on alpha (#1124/#1170 chain): lexical FTS retrieves glossary.identifiers, but it did not survive RRF + top-5 rerank. The fix reserves a final-top-K slot for each sub-query's best chunk (mcp.rag.rerank.compound-slots-enabled, default true). expected.doc_ids lists BOTH needs' docs: recall@k only passes when the reserved-slot cut keeps each need's chunk in the top-5.

fixtures.query: what does an invoice number look like and what permission is needed to read an invoice
fixtures.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED residual (#1180, item-4 probe 6/7): the permission clause pulls security.role-permission-matrix as top lexical hit and glossary.identifiers (dense-miss, lexical-recovered per #1170) is pushed out of the top-5 by the RRF + whole-query rerank. Both docs must survive the cut for the answer to cover both halves. Actor carries the role/permission-view codes so the matrix doc is visible pre-rerank.

fixtures.query: what is the format of a workorder number and which permission do I need to view an estimate
fixtures.notes: Same compound shape as the verified invoice case: identifier-format need (glossary.identifiers, dense-miss class per #1178) joined with a permission need served by a domain doc. Guards the slot-reservation cut on a second doc pair; live status to be confirmed on alpha per the #1124 runbook.
